irs_eedi.title: Indian Register of Shipping, Energy Efficiency Design Index: reference line parameters and reduction factors (MARPOL Annex VI, Reg. 24)

assume.title: Modelling assumption of this application; documented in docs/decisions/0008

reference_lines.note: Reference line = a · capacity^(−c). Taken from a classification-society summary of MARPOL Annex VI; confirm against the regulation text.

reduction_by_index.note: Attained index ≈ reference × (1 − X). EEDI/EEXI: X between 0 and the type's phase-3 / EEXI maximum (build year unknown), centred halfway. EIV: the reference lines were fitted to EIV values, so X is centred on 0 with ±25% scatter.

max_reduction.note: Phase-3 EEDI reduction: 30% for most types; up to 50% for the largest container ships (EEXI likewise).

min_slope.note: The index is used only where the reference-line exponent c ≥ 0.30 (bulk, gas, tanker, LNG, combination, ro-ro); for container, general cargo, reefer and cruise ships the line is too flat to identify size.
